# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Susan](../character/susan.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Ruby Gillis possesses real showy looks, characterized by a plump and striking figure along with a brilliant complexion. She has large, bright-blue eyes and wears her hair in a long yellow braid.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful and good-tempered individual who enjoys the pleasant things in life, though she is inclined to succumb to hysterics in stressful situations. She harbors a mortal dread of fat green caterpillars. Her ambitions center largely on romance, as she is deeply focused on young men and aspires to have numerous suitors devoted to her as she grows up, intending to teach for only two years before getting married.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis is an [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolgirl known for having a wealth of knowledge on various subjects due to her many older sisters. She is part of the close-knit social circle at school alongside classmates [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaks her ankle after falling off a roof, Ruby is among the schoolmates who visit and comfort her during her bed rest. Ruby later joins the advanced class formed by Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) to prepare for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV.
